name: AudioFetcher
tagline: The core loop is genuinely one-shottable: a small local UI, yt-dlp for the fetch, ffmpeg for the encode, files land in a folder. What is not a one sitting is everything that makes a public converter feel reliable week after week · YouTube bot checks, cookies/PO tokens, geo blocks, fair queues, abuse protection, and a hosted path so non-technical people never open a terminal. Build the personal script; do not expect one prompt to replace a maintained public service.
